title: SkinAdvisor: An AI-Driven Decision Framework for Skin Production Planning via Multi-Modal Transformer Sales Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.15023v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Skins, cosmetic in-game items, are a primary revenue stream for modern online games, yet production decisions (which skins to make, when to release, how to price) remain driven by intuition and retrospective analytics. We present SkinAdvisor, an AI-driven decision framework for skin production planning, powered by SkinCast, a deployed multi-modal Transformer forecasting 180-day per-day sales trajectories for unreleased skins. SkinCast couples four encoders: a pretrained Informer for player-preference time series, a pretrained Player-Hero-Skin graph embedder for relational priors, and two lightweight Transformers for skin attributes and release context, fused through a shared backbone with a local-plus-global day-x positional encoding and decoded by an N-layer Informer in a single non-autoregressive pass. SkinAdvisor plugs these forecasts into a serving pipeline (Select -> Fill -> Infer -> Sales -> ROI -> Ranking) that ranks candidate s

translated_title: SkinAdvisor：基于多模态Transformer销量预测的皮肤生产规划AI驱动决策框架
translated_abstract: 皮肤（Skins）作为游戏内的装饰性道具，是现代在线游戏的主要收入来源，然而其生产决策（制作哪些皮肤、何时发布、如何定价）仍主要依赖直觉和回顾性分析。我们提出了SkinAdvisor，一个用于皮肤生产规划的AI驱动决策框架，其核心是SkinCast——一个已部署的多模态Transformer模型，可预测未发布皮肤未来180天的逐日销量轨迹。SkinCast耦合了四个编码器：一个用于玩家偏好时间序列的预训练Informer、一个提供关系先验的预训练玩家-英雄-皮肤图嵌入器，以及两个分别用于皮肤属性和发布上下文的轻量级Transformer，通过共享骨干网络融合，采用局部加全局的第x天位置编码，并由N层Informer在单次非自回归过程中解码。SkinAdvisor将这些预测结果接入一条服务流水线（选择→填充→推断→销量→ROI→排名），对候选皮肤方案进行排序……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出SkinAdvisor框架，利用已部署的多模态Transformer模型SkinCast预测未发布游戏皮肤未来180天的逐日销量轨迹，并通过一条服务流水线对候选皮肤方案进行排序，为皮肤的生产、发布与定价决策提供AI驱动的量化支持。
en_tdlr: The paper presents SkinAdvisor, an AI-driven decision framework powered by SkinCast, a deployed multi-modal Transformer that forecasts 180-day daily sales trajectories for unreleased game skins, which are plugged into a serving pipeline to rank candidate skin production plans.
